title: Section 12 CPC — Bar to further suit

content.overview: Section 12 CPC bars a further suit on a cause of action when the plaintiff is precluded by the rules from instituting that further suit. It is not a restatement of res judicata.
content.study: Read Section 12 with the rule that actually precludes the further suit — commonly Order II rule 2 or a withdrawal without liberty under Order XXIII. Section 11 asks whether a former suit was heard and finally decided. Section 12 asks whether a rule forbids a second suit on the same cause of action. Plead the rule, not a slogan.

sections.heading: Practice point
sections.body: Identify the precluding rule first. Then plead Section 12. Do not collapse this into Section 11.
